description: GETWAB is an AI-powered federal procurement and capture intelligence platform built for federal contractors, capture teams, and GovCon advisors. Ask questions in plain English to find and qualify best-fit opportunities, assess bid/no-bid decisions, research agencies and markets, identify incumbents and competitors, and analyze historical awards, subcontracts, entities, and exclusions. Continue your research in the GETWAB platform to explore underlying records, compare the market, and build a deeper capture strategy.

defaultPrompt: Find open opportunities for NAICS 541512 and PSC DA01, including deadlines, agencies, and small-business set-asides.
Find open subcontracting opportunities for NAICS 541512 and PSC DA01, including primes, locations, and deadlines.
Analyze the federal market for NAICS 541512 and PSC DA01, including spending, agencies, incumbents, and competitors.
